'''2011 Belgium Regionals Carlos Navarro LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Carlos Navarro]] at [[2011 Belgium Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
